The chiton has an oval shape with a distinct reddish-pink leathery girdle surrounding eight overlapping dorsal plates. The plates feature intricate wavy patterns in white and dark brown/black. The head is at the right side (anterior), appearing blunt and indistinct without visible eyes or tentacles.
